name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs—open and merged—for two weeks. This lets us measure its impact without risking workflow disruption, giving us real data on false positives, missed issues, and developer friction. The trade-off is temporary noise in review channels, but it’s smaller than the risk of breaking critical PRs with untested automation. After two weeks, we’ll have the evidence to decide whether to expand or restrict its scope.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode trains reviewers to ignore *all* autofeedback—not just noise. Better: run PR-Agent only on PRs where a human reviewer has already approved the change, measuring its value in reducing missed issues. Settle it with a two-week trial where we compare PR-Agent feedback against human reviews on the same PRs, then decide based on whether it catches issues humans miss.
